text.p: MotorVac Technologies Inc Wednesday restated financial results for the first three months of 1996 to reflect an adjustment in the company's cost of sales.

In a statement, the maker of engine cleaning machines said it had losses of $491,997 in the first quarter of 1996, $317,407 in the second quarter and $126,902 in the third quarter. That compared with previously reported losses of $297,443 in the first quarter, $254,643 in the second quarter and $65,784 in the third quarter.
The company said the adjustment reflects a shifting of the cost of sales between the fourth quarter and the first three quarters of 1996.
For the year ended December 31, MotorVac said it lost $1.28 million compared with a loss of $3.1 million in 1995. Sales rose 64 percent to $8.2 million from $5.0 million.
The company said it is on track with its business plan objectives for the first quarter of 1997.
